payload.summary: MAR-2920: record publication is staged write, fsync, authority check, hard link, kind-directory fsync, staging unlink and authority acceptance; it no longer defends against directory replacement inside that sequence.
rationale: The previous publication path carried about 300 lines of mutable state and directory witnesses to detect same-user processes replacing directories mid-write, which is out of proportion for a local repository tool.
Planning currentness, layout limits and acceptPreparation/acceptPublication stay in the canonical publication authority because cache hydration after an add depends on them.
rules: Writers stage only while holding the operation lock, so the next holder removes every recognised staging entry after checking all of them; unrecognised names or types remove nothing.
Post-commit failures are captured per phase with the existing priority and never roll back the link.
Crash-quarantine staging names from earlier releases are still recognised and removed.

searchText: record publication staging hard link fsync cleanup leftovers quarantine simplification MAR-2920
